description: 外部验证关闭趋势 dashboard 契约。该 gate 聚合 closure plan、closure work queue、proof-ref gate、category runbooks 和可选 live proof gate，输出按 owner/category/status 的本地趋势 JSON 与 stale alert 摘要；不发送真实通知，不连接外部 issue tracker，不把 alert acknowledgement 视为 live evidence closure。

alertPolicy.staleWhen: work item remains unresolved, proof-ref is missing, category live gate is pending, manual triage remains open, or policy guardrail still requires review
alertPolicy.shipGate: blocked while any stale alert, missing proof-ref, manual triage, policy guardrail, or category live pending item remains
alertPolicy.ackPolicy: alert acknowledgement is not accepted as live evidence closure

privacyBoundary: Closure trend dashboard 只保存 owner/category/status、work item id、occurrence count、age、stale reason、proof-ref/category-live 状态和本地 artifact path；不得保存真实 URL、token、secret、DSN、私钥、生产日志 payload、用户输入、报告正文或外部账号数据。
nonClaims: Does not prove any external live validation has passed.
Does not send real alerts or create external issues.
Does not close proof-ref, category live gate, third-party audit, or certification blockers.
Does not authorize production credential use.
